title: i was able to port my game to the nintendo (new) 3DS
author: noz_
selftext:
With all the console ports now appearing on pc thanks to ai made me think if the opposite direction was also possible - and it is!

download the 3dsx/cia here: [https://github.com/njlent/tougelike-3ds-pub](https://github.com/njlent/tougelike-3ds-pub)

I was able to port my full game 1:1 (except for the visual downgrade ofc) to the nintento 3DS with claude. HUGE thanks to [devkitPro](https://github.com/devkitPro) for the working SDK. For the process i pointed claude to the source of [azahar](https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar) (emulator) to build some custom tooling and prompt it to rebuild most of the game in native C++ until it hits the desired performance goal.

The game logic was split from the render anyway, so it was fairly easy to match, even savegames works cross plattform.  
  
If you have a 3ds, or new 3ds /xl etc with homebrew, PLEASE try it out and tell me how it works - i could only test it with my old 2ds here locally, wich work ok - a "new" 3ds should have roughly 3 times the power, emulators work fine.

(or if you dont have a 3ds you can still play it in browser here: [https://njlent.de/tougelike/](https://njlent.de/tougelike/) )

comments.body: This game looks amazing! I cant get the gamepad to work on the browser version. Do you have a github for the original game. Do you have a windows release for the game? thanks!

replies.author: noz_
replies.body: thank you! im actually working on a gamepad fix as we speak, give me 1h max then it should be deployed - i dont have an open github for the main game, just the discord - ill ping you when its ready

replies.author: noz_
replies.body: Fix is live - its a bit tricky in the complex menus like the garage, but add an optional cursor mode in the next days aswell - the web version works on any plattform with webgl, if you have chrome you can also add it to the desktop (might need to transfer the savegame in options tho)

replies.author: Thermoptic
replies.body: Amazing, thank you so much! I know that its possible to create a wrapper for a webgl game so it has a built in server and can start via an exe file so you can have it on your hdd and play it offline and local, that would be really fun to have some time in the future if you have the time :) Keep up the good work!
